tabGroups.title: Browser Tab Groups
tabGroups.description: Configure automatic grouping rules. Newly opened tabs are added to matching native browser groups.

autoGroup.title: Default Auto Grouping
autoGroup.description: Custom rules run first. If none match, choose either AI auto grouping or domain auto grouping. They cannot be enabled together.

aiAutoGroup.title: AI Auto Grouping
aiAutoGroup.description: When enabled, new tabs match rules first. If none match, the URL, title, and page description are sent to AI to join an existing group or create a new one.
aiAutoGroup.instructionsPlaceholder: Example: prioritize project-based groups; put technical docs in Development; do not merge shopping, video, or social sites into work groups.
aiAutoGroup.instructionsHint: These requirements become the base AI grouping logic and only apply when no manual rule matches.

domainAutoGroup.title: Domain Auto Grouping
domainAutoGroup.description: When enabled, tabs that miss custom rules are grouped by their main domain, such as www.baidu.com into baidu, with a random color.

tracking.title: Activity tracking
tracking.description: Records when each tab was last used and on which days you used the browser, to show idle times, auto archive and suggest tidy-ups.
tracking.label: Track tab activity
tracking.privacy: Stays on this device: never synced or exported. AI tidy-up and the assistant only see titles, cleaned-up URLs and idle times of non-private tabs when you ask them. Turning it off stops tracking and wipes what was recorded.
tracking.offDescription: Tracking stops and the recorded activity is wiped. Auto archive and making room automatically become unavailable; archived tabs are not affected.

autoArchive.title: Auto archive
autoArchive.description: Tabs idle past the threshold are closed automatically after being written to the archive, where they can be searched and restored. Turning it on is not retroactive: idle time counts from that moment.
autoArchive.thresholdHint: Never within 15 minutes after the browser starts; at most 30 tabs per run

countByHint.usage-days: Not opened for 7 days (only days you use the browser count): coming back from a vacation never empties your tabs
countByHint.calendar: Wall clock time, whether or not you used the browser

modeHint.auto: Archive when due; undo whole batches from the popup or the archive
modeHint.confirm: Wait for your confirmation when due; the icon shows a reminder
modeHint.mark-only: Only mark tabs as expired in the tab center, never close them

protection.title: Protection
protection.alwaysOn: Pinned tabs, the current tab of each window, tabs you locked and tabs being saved with HamHome are never closed automatically.
protection.audible: Protect tabs playing sound (or within 10 minutes after)
protection.groupedHint: Off by default: with automatic grouping most tabs would never expire. You can also protect a single group in its Tab grouping rule
protection.dirtyFormsHint: Pages holding input you edited but did not submit stay open
protection.minOpenTabs: Keep at least this many tabs
protection.minOpenTabsHint: Nothing is archived while no more tabs are open; 0 means no limit

locked.title: Locked tabs ({{count}})
locked.empty: Lock a tab with the lock icon in the list; locks survive browser restarts

skipped.min-open-tabs: Last check {{time}}: not more tabs open than you keep

budget.title: Tab budget
budget.description: A limit for open tabs; pinned tabs do not count. Going over only gives a gentle hint by default and never blocks opening a tab.

overActionHint.badge-only: Only turn the icon count red
overActionHint.nudge: One gentle hint in the corner of the current page, 15 minute cooldown
overActionHint.auto-archive: Archive the least recently used tabs idle for over an hour, with undo

budget.makeRoomDescription: When over budget, the least recently used tabs are archived automatically (only unprotected tabs idle for 60+ minutes and not opened in the last 10 minutes), exactly as many as needed, always with undo.
budget.showBadge: Show the tab count on the icon
budget.showBadgeHint: Shows the number of open tabs even with the budget off
